_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Certification Data for Non-Nuclear Level I Material
summary: The Certification Data for Non-Nuclear Level I Material report provides the Government with minimum vendor certification data reporting requirements for chemical composition, mechanical properties, and traceability of Level I material.
use_relationship:
The Certification Data for Non-Nuclear Level I Material report will provide the Government with descriptions of the minimum vendor certification data reporting requirements for chemical composition, mechanical properties, and traceability requirements for Level I material.
This Data Item Description contains the general format, content, and intended use information for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81020.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Format for the required certification data report are represented by the examples provided on pages 4 and 5.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Material certification data shall include quantitative chemical composition and mechanical properties required by specification and contract. Material certification test reports shall be traceable to the material through unique traceability codes marked on the material and on all test reports. The material traceability marking shall be maintained through all phases of fabrication and manufacturing.

preparation_instructions.title: Data Format
preparation_instructions.content: Material certification data shall be recorded on the testing company's letterhead or standard certification form and bear the date of testing or certification of the material, name (typed or printed), organizational title, and signature of the authorized representative of the company the testing company's address, and contact information such as telephone number and/or email address. Signatures may be handwritten or a verifiable electronic signature. Certification data supplied to the Government shall be the original mill material certification and the testing facility who supplied the testing for the mill if the mill did not perform it. Exact photocopies of certification data are acceptable.

preparation_instructions.title: Certification Data Required
preparation_instructions.content: Certification data must represent the finished product. If the starting material or raw stock is processed in a manner that will not affect its chemical composition or mechanical properties (e.g. machining), the original mill certification is acceptable. Recertification of the mechanical properties or chemical composition is required if a metal working process, heat treatment or alloying used during fabrication alters the original condition of the material. The mechanical properties or chemical composition of the material must be re-determined and be representative of the altered condition. The altered mechanical properties or chemical composition must be within specification and be part of the certification data submitted to the government. The altered material shall be uniquely re-identified (marked), and traceable to certification data.

preparation_instructions.title: Foreign Certification
preparation_instructions.content: In addition to the paragraph 4 data format requirements, country of origin shall be identified. Foreign languages on the certifications must be translated into English. The units of measure must be the same as those required by the contract or specification. Those units of measure not in conformance with the contract or specification must be converted. Translations and conversions may be annotated on the certifications, if space permits, or placed in an addendum in the same format as the foreign certification data. Such translation or conversion shall remain traceable to the material and be identified as to origin with name, title, signature, and date of the authorized representative of the company making the translation or conversion.

preparation_instructions.title: Signature
preparation_instructions.content: The Certification Report shall contain the signature of the contractor's authorized representative responsible for ensuring that the equipment being delivered/service being performed is in accordance with contract requirements. Electronic signatures are acceptable provided they meet additional requirements of this DID.
